G-ACC.note: the 17 orphan accusers of jca_android, closed by Group 3: 12 negated twins fused into their siblings on 11 arrows, PBEKeySpecSpec.err1 fused on the same arrow as err2/err3, and 4 absorbed into their automata (SecureRandomSpec.g4 and PBEKeySpecSpec.f1/f2 with self-loops and an ORDER-unmapped row; KeyPairGeneratorSpec.initError as an Inits alternative mapped to i3). The gate is now expected to be silent over jca_android in both directions, so a finding it reports is a regression and not an expectation. The generic set's one orphan is informative and was never in this record.
